name: GhOsT77 Security
payout_note: USDC payouts go only to this address on Base. Do not pay any other wallet.

items.name: Website Fix
items.description: One-time fixes for a site you own or manage: broken pages, links, and forms; mobile layout problems; missing security headers, where your host allows; HTTPS and certificate issues; a short written summary of what was changed.

items.name: Website Upkeep
items.description: A monthly check plus small fixes: monitoring of HTTPS and certificate expiry, security header checks, small fixes when something slips, a short status note each month. Cancel any time.

items.name: Hacked Site Cleanup
items.description: One-time cleanup of malware, spam injections, a defacement, or a browser security warning on one site you own. Written record, basic hardening you approve, help requesting a Google Safe Browsing review if a warning is showing. If a missed backdoor means the same infection is still there within 14 days, it is re-cleaned at no extra charge. Not a guarantee the site is safe or that Google will remove a warning.

items.name: FAQ Chatbot Setup
items.description: One-time setup of an embeddable question box for one website you own, answering from your FAQ text. Default answers use keyword matching; no paid API is required. Not a sales agent, phone or voice bot, or legal, medical, or financial advice. Live demo on the chatbot page.

items.name: FAQ Chatbot Care
items.description: Optional monthly care for one FAQ chatbot: FAQ updates you send and a check that the widget still loads. Cancel any time.

items.name: Quick security review
items.description: A fast written pass before launch or a sale. Covers security headers, TLS and certificate expiry, CORS, cookie flags, HTTP to HTTPS, exposed debug/admin/config paths, unauthenticated endpoint checks, known-vulnerable dependencies (OSV), committed secrets (redacted), and Python static analysis. Up to 1 public GitHub repo. AI-assisted and human-approved. Not a penetration test, certification, or guarantee.

items.name: Standard security review
items.description: Everything in Quick, plus login, session, password-reset and token handling checks with test accounts you provide, role-to-role access checks, OWASP Top 10 / API Top 10 style non-destructive checks, and one retest of fixed findings within 14 days. Prefer test or staging.

items.name: Deep security review
items.description: Everything in Standard, plus a step-by-step review of every in-scope endpoint and role (including business-logic abuse), source review of authentication, access control and input handling, threat notes, a prioritized fix plan, and one retest of fixed findings within 30 days.
